verdict.rationale: Greptile's quickstart says you can "configure review triggers", and greptile.json settings override the dashboard per PR. On-demand review is available locally via `greptile review` on a feature-branch diff. The evidence never details which trigger conditions exist, so the specific controls the story asks for are unconfirmed. Missing for 10: documented skip-draft-PR behavior, branch-based filters, label-based filters, an in-PR comment or mention to trigger a review on demand, and any hands-on corroboration of trigger configuration.
